description: Start here: what the learner should do now. Reviews due (with dates), concepts to relearn, lessons in progress, the next lesson, and next_step {action: review|continue|start|author|wait, tool, arguments, text} naming the call to make with its arguments (language included where the tool takes one). With the minutes a day the learner gave, minutes_per_day and next_step.estimated_minutes size the step. display_markdown is the plan in `language`, ready to show. Dates (due_date, next_review_date) are days in get_server_info.time_zone.

language.description: fr or en: the language of display_markdown and of the next step; defaults to the language of the learner's last lesson, else the server's

learner_id.description: one stable id per learner; defaults to persistence.learner_id_default

now_ms.description: epoch ms, for deterministic scheduling: the session started with it stamps its answers, ratings and reviews there; defaults to the server clock

name: get_study_plan
